answer: The admission bond is time locked for 24 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are logged in vault, expire in reef, and fable lists each expiry. An adversary running 79 aliases hence needs 16 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3117 identities would post 2150 proofs and burn roughly 71 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
